title: Normalized open compact-support comparison
statement: In a Cartesian square U\to X over V\to Y of separated finite-type k-schemes with horizontal maps open, fix a compactification c of X\to Y and its actual pullback d. For each admissible condensed coefficient Lambda, the functors d_! followed by open extension V\to Y and open extension U\to X followed by c_! are naturally isomorphic on Loc(Dctf(U,Lambda)). The open transpose of this comparison is inverse to the specified target-restriction mate; equivalently that mate followed by the open unit and the pullback of the comparison is the identity. Notions and canonical constructions: [sk-def-localizing-closure], [def-sfb-mate-open-restriction-maps], [sk-def-nagata-sketch-data].

source.place: Proof (2) and (3), transpose and invertibility of proper/open interchange

proof.text: Express the specified target restriction map as a natural transformation built from the open-extension compositor, the proper restriction mate, and the inverse open unit. Every component is invertible by open-square mate invertibility.

The proper image of open extension vanishes on the closed complement on the entire localizing hull. Hence its open counit is invertible, since the open restriction is invertible by the triangle identity and the closed restriction is between zero objects; use joint conservativity of open and closed restriction.

Transpose the inverse target restriction under the open adjunction. It is a composite of the open extension of an isomorphism with the invertible supported open counit, hence an isomorphism. The adjunction Hom equation and the original target restriction inverse identity give exactly the asserted normalization.

theorem mateOpenCompactSupportExchange
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hpl : p ≠ ℓ)
    (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (a : U ⟶ X) (q : U ⟶ V) (v : V ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion a] [IsOpenImmersion v] (sq : IsPullback a q f v) :
    ∃ β : ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ U).ι ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ (c.ofIsPullback sq) ⋙
          (openImmersionLowerShriek Λ v).mapDerivedCategory) ≅
        ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ U).ι ⋙
          (openImmersionLowerShriek Λ a).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c),
      ∀ M : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ U).FullSubcategory,
        mateOpenTargetLowerShriek Λ sq c M.obj ≫
            (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction Λ v).unit.app
              ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ (c.ofIsPullback sq)).obj M.obj) ≫
            (upperStar Λ v).mapDerivedCategory.map (β.hom.app M) = 𝟙 _
